references.text: The Levites were to begin their service in the tent of meeting after purification, as this verse confirms they did.
The Levites were given to Aaron and his sons to serve in the tent of meeting, which is fulfilled here.
Describes further details about the Levites' service in the tent of meeting and the age limits for their work.
The Levites were given to Aaron to serve him and perform duties at the tent of meeting.
Describes the Levites' service and work at the tent of meeting.
The Israelites did everything just as the Lord had commanded Moses—the same formula of obedience used here.
Moses did everything just as the Lord had commanded him—parallel to the obedience described in this verse.
Describes the Levites' service under Aaron and his sons in the house of the Lord.
